Title: Data Retention and Deletion
Content:  You have the option to delete your Safqah account at any point from the Settings menu, or by sending a request to privacy@safqah.co. Upon account deletion, we erase your linked financial data and Safqah account data (email address, projects, etc.), except where legally obligated to retain certain information. In cases with no legal obligations, your data is fully removed from all our systems, including backups, within 60 days. Note: Deleting your Safqah account is distinct from unsubscribing from our services. To cancel your subscription, go to Safqah Settings → Subscription → Manage your Subscription.
